1707: /// Handle a `sync-collection` REPORT: return the changes since the client's
1708: /// opaque token (or the full snapshot when no token is supplied) and mint a
1709: /// new token for the next incremental sync.
1710: ///
1711: /// Deleted resources are represented by a response whose `D:status` is
1712: /// `HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found` as a direct child of `D:response`, per RFC
1713: /// 6578. Invalid tokens fail safely with 400. Pagination is bounded by
1714: /// `MAX_RESULTS` and the new token always advances past the last returned
1715: /// revision, so no change is skipped.
1716: async fn handle_sync_collection(
1717:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
1718:     principal_id: &str,
1719:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
1720:     sync: &query::SyncCollection,
1721: ) -> Response {
1722:     let Some(access) = read_access_for_role(&calendar.role) else {
1723:         return dav_calendar_not_found();
1724:     };
1725:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
1726:     let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
1727:     let now = accounts.now();
1728: 
1729:     let mut responses = Vec::new();
1730:     let new_revision;
1731: 
1732:     match &sync.sync_token {
1733:         Some(token) => {
1734:             // Incremental sync: decode the opaque token and page the change log.
1735:             let Some(revision) = accounts.decode_sync_token(token) else {
1736:                 return dav_bad_request("invalid sync token");
1737:             };
1738:             let changes = match repository
1739:                 .list_changes_since(calendar.calendar_id, revision, MAX_RESULTS)
1740:                 .await
1741:             {
1742:                 Ok(changes) => changes,
1743:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1744:             };
1745:             new_revision = changes.last().map(|change| change.id).unwrap_or(revision);
1746:             for change in &changes {
1747:                 match change.change_type.as_str() {
1748:                     "deleted" => {
1749:                         let resource_name = change.resource_name.clone().unwrap_or_default();
1750:                         let href = format!(
1751:                             "/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/{}.ics",
1752:                             calendar.calendar_id, resource_name
1753:                         );
1754:                         responses.push(sync_deleted_response_xml(&href));
1755:                     }
1756:                     "created" | "updated" => {
1757:                         let Some(event_id) = change.event_id else {
1758:                             continue;
1759:                         };
1760:                         let resource = match repository
1761:                             .ensure_resource(calendar.calendar_id, event_id, now)
1762:                             .await
1763:                         {
1764:                             Ok(resource) => resource,
1765:                             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1766:                         };
1767:                         match events.event(calendar.calendar_id, event_id).await {
1768:                             Ok(Some(event)) => {
1769:                                 if let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(
1770:                                     accounts.pool(),
1771:                                     calendar.calendar_id,
1772:                                     &resource,
1773:                                     &event,
1774:                                     access,
1775:                                 )
1776:                                 .await
1777:                                 {
1778:                                     let href = format!(
1779:                                         "/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/{}.ics",
1780:                                         calendar.calendar_id, resource.resource_name
1781:                                     );
1782:                                     responses.push(sync_changed_response_xml(&href, &etag, &ical));
1783:                                 }
1784:                             }
1785:                             Ok(None) => {}
1786:                             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1787:                         }
1788:                     }
1789:                     _ => {}
1790:                 }
1791:             }
1792:         }
1793:         None => {
1794:             // Initial snapshot: return every currently exposed event and mint a
1795:             // token at the latest revision so the next call is incremental.
1796:             let event_ids = match repository
1797:                 .list_exposed_event_ids(calendar.calendar_id)
1798:                 .await
1799:             {
1800:                 Ok(event_ids) => event_ids,
1801:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1802:             };
1803:             for event_id in &event_ids {
1804:                 let resource = match repository
1805:                     .ensure_resource(calendar.calendar_id, *event_id, now)
1806:                     .await
1807:                 {
1808:                     Ok(resource) => resource,
1809:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1810:                 };
1811:                 match events.event(calendar.calendar_id, *event_id).await {
1812:                     Ok(Some(event)) => {
1813:                         if let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(
1814:                             accounts.pool(),
1815:                             calendar.calendar_id,
1816:                             &resource,
1817:                             &event,
1818:                             access,
1819:                         )
1820:                         .await
1821:                         {
1822:                             let href = format!(
1823:                                 "/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/{}.ics",
1824:                                 calendar.calendar_id, resource.resource_name
1825:                             );
1826:                             responses.push(sync_changed_response_xml(&href, &etag, &ical));
1827:                         }
1828:                     }
1829:                     Ok(None) => {}
1830:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1831:                 }
1832:             }
1833:             new_revision = match repository.latest_revision(calendar.calendar_id).await {
1834:                 Ok(revision) => revision,
1835:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1836:             };
1837:         }
1838:     }
1839: 
1840:     let new_token = accounts.encode_sync_token(new_revision);
1841:     let collection_href = format!("/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/", calendar.calendar_id);
1842:     let collection_response = sync_collection_response_xml(&collection_href, &new_token);
1843:     let body = std::iter::once(collection_response.as_str())
1844:         .chain(responses.iter().map(|response| response.as_str()))
1845:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1846:         .join("\n");
1847:     let xml = format!(
1848:         r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
1849: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
1850: {body}
1851: </D:multistatus>"#
1852:     );
1853:     (
1854:         StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
1855:         [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
1856:         xml,
1857:     )
1858:         .into_response()
1859: }

1986: /// Authenticate a DAV request, checking the rate limit first.
1987: /// Returns `Ok((session, request))` on success, or `Err(response)` on failure.
1988: async fn authenticate_dav_request(
1989:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
1990:     request: Request,
1991: ) -> Result<(DavSession, Request), Response> {
1992:     let authorization = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION).cloned();
1993:     let Some(authorization) = authorization else {
1994:         accounts.metrics().record_unauthorized();
1995:         return Err(dav_unauthorized());
1996:     };
1997:     let client_key = client_key_from_request(&request);
1998:     if let Err((retry_after, _)) = accounts.check_auth_rate_limit(&client_key) {
1999:         return Err(dav_rate_limited(retry_after));
2000:     }
2001:     match accounts.authenticate(&authorization).await {
2002:         Ok(session) => {
2003:             accounts.record_auth_success();
2004:             Ok((session, request))
2005:         }
2006:         Err(_) => {
2007:             accounts.record_auth_failure();
2008:             Err(dav_unauthorized())
2009:         }
2010:     }
2011: }

2086: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
2087:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
2088:         return Vec::new();
2089:     };
2090:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
2091:         authorize_calendar_action(
2092:             UserStatus::Active,
2093:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
2094:             Some(role),
2095:             action,
2096:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
2097:     };
2098:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
2099:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
2100:     if can_read {
2101:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
2102:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
2103:     }
2104:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
2105:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
2106:     }
2107:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
2108:     if writable {
2109:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
2110:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
2111:     }
2112:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
2113:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
2114:     }
2115:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
2116:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
2117:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
2118:     }
2119:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
2120:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
2121:     }
2122:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
2123:         privileges.push("DAV:all");

2260: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event, rendered
2261: /// at the caller's read scope. Free-busy readers receive a placeholder that
2262: /// carries only the time window. Recurring events are serialized as a series
2263: /// (master + exceptions) in a single VCALENDAR.
2264: async fn ical_and_etag(
2265:     pool: &SqlitePool,
2266:     calendar_id: i64,
2267:     resource: &CaldavEventResource,
2268:     event: &Event,
2269:     access: DavReadAccess,
2270: ) -> Option<(String, String)> {
2271:     let timing = match &event.timing {
2272:         EventTiming::Timed {
2273:             start_utc,
2274:             end_utc,
2275:             timezone,
2276:         } => CaldavIcalTiming::Timed {
2277:             start_utc: *start_utc,
2278:             end_utc: *end_utc,
2279:             timezone: timezone.clone(),
2280:         },
2281:         EventTiming::AllDay {
2282:             start_date,
2283:             end_date,
2284:         } => CaldavIcalTiming::AllDay {
2285:             start_date: start_date.clone(),
2286:             end_date: end_date.clone(),
2287:         },
2288:     };
2289:     let status = match event.status {
2290:         EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
2291:         EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
2292:         EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
2293:     }
2294:     .to_owned();
2295:     let free_busy = matches!(access, DavReadAccess::FreeBusy);
2296: 
2297:     // Allowlisted client-owned metadata (T16). Only exposed to detail readers;
2298:     // free-busy placeholders carry only the time window.
2299:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(pool.clone());
2300:     let client_properties = repository
2301:         .load_client_properties(event.id)
2302:         .await
2303:         .ok()
2304:         .flatten()
2305:         .unwrap_or_default();
2306: 
2307:     let recurrence_rule: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
2308:         "SELECT recurrence_rule FROM events WHERE id = ? AND calendar_id = ?",
2309:     )
2310:     .bind(event.id)
2311:     .bind(calendar_id)
2312:     .fetch_optional(pool)
2313:     .await
2314:     .ok()
2315:     .flatten()
2316:     .filter(|r: &String| !r.is_empty());
2317: 
2318:     let ical = if let Some(rrule) = recurrence_rule {
2319:         let exceptions = fetch_recurring_exceptions(pool, event.id, &timing).await;
2320:         let master = CaldavIcalEvent {
2321:             uid: resource.uid.clone(),
2322:             summary: event.title.clone(),
2323:             description: event.description.clone(),
2324:             location: event.location.clone(),
2325:             status: Some(status.clone()),
2326:             timing: timing.clone(),
2327:             dtstamp: event.created_at,
2328:             sequence: event.version as u64,
2329:             free_busy,
2330:             rrule: Some(rrule),
2331:             exdates: exceptions
2332:                 .iter()
2333:                 .filter(|e| e.is_deleted)
2334:                 .map(|e| e.date_value.clone())
2335:                 .collect(),
2336:             recurrence_id: None,
2337:             categories: client_properties.categories.clone(),
2338:             url: client_properties.url.clone(),
2339:             transp: client_properties.transp.clone(),
2340:             alarms: client_properties.alarms.clone(),
2341:             x_properties: client_properties.x_properties.clone(),
2342:         };
2343:         let exception_events: Vec<CaldavIcalEvent> = exceptions
2344:             .iter()
2345:             .filter(|e| !e.is_deleted)
2346:             .map(|e| CaldavIcalEvent {
2347:                 uid: resource.uid.clone(),
2348:                 summary: e.title.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| event.title.clone()),
2349:                 description: e.description.clone(),
2350:                 location: e.location.clone(),
2351:                 status: e
2352:                     .status
2353:                     .clone()
2354:                     .map(|s| s.to_uppercase())
2355:                     .or_else(|| Some(status.clone())),
2356:                 timing: e.timing.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| timing.clone()),
2357:                 dtstamp: event.created_at,
2358:                 sequence: event.version as u64,
2359:                 free_busy,
2360:                 rrule: None,
2361:                 exdates: Vec::new(),
2362:                 recurrence_id: Some(e.date_value.clone()),
2363:                 categories: Vec::new(),
2364:                 url: None,
2365:                 transp: None,
2366:                 alarms: Vec::new(),
2367:                 x_properties: Vec::new(),
2368:             })
2369:             .collect();
2370:         serialize_recurring_series(&master, &exception_events)
2371:     } else {
2372:         serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
2373:             uid: resource.uid.clone(),
2374:             summary: event.title.clone(),
2375:             description: event.description.clone(),
2376:             location: event.location.clone(),
2377:             status: Some(status),
2378:             timing,
2379:             dtstamp: event.created_at,
2380:             sequence: event.version as u64,
2381:             free_busy,
2382:             rrule: None,
2383:             exdates: Vec::new(),
2384:             recurrence_id: None,
2385:             categories: client_properties.categories,

2387:             transp: client_properties.transp,
2388:             alarms: client_properties.alarms,
2389:             x_properties: client_properties.x_properties,
2390:         })
2391:     };
2392:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
2393:     Some((ical, etag))
